name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Communications & Change Adoption | Clear Writing, Multi-Channel Campaigns & Leader Enablement
summary: Communicator and operator with 15+ years translating complex systems and changes into clear, audience-specific messages that people act on. Writes newsletters, guides, and thought leadership for B2B audiences; builds and measures multi-channel email campaigns; and has led teams through new processes and tools, including two years training and leading a team of 20 (later 8) at Wix and rolling out automated training programs at Birdeye. Works directly with executives and turns loosely defined intent into precise, usable guidance.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Write and publish thought leadership, newsletters, and educational guides that explain systems and operational change to non-technical business audiences.
Translate stakeholders' loosely defined ideas and feedback into precise, structured messaging and instructions.
Build and run segmented, multi-step email programs, tracking engagement and conversion in GA4 and the CRM and adjusting content based on results.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led integrated inbound, paid, and content strategies as strategic lead, coordinating execution across internal departments.
Presented performance findings and recommendations to client leadership in quarterly business reviews.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Built communication workflows and automated training sequences that brought a diverse network of 15-20 partners onto new tools, retaining all but one (~94%).
Equipped partners with messaging and talking points to explain product value to their own customers.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Led the sales team and built internal processes that strengthened cross-team alignment and reduced handoff errors.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led and developed a team of onboarding specialists for two years (20, later 8), including hiring, onboarding, and training new team members.
Built sales training for tenured account executives, and drove team initiatives that took a new vertical from proof of concept to a profitable business line.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Advised C-suite leaders at agencies and professional-services firms on adopting new operational systems, and escalated risks to leadership early.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
